content.short: AdaDomains is a Cardano naming system that lets users own .ada domains as NFTs and resolve them to wallets, websites, and contact data.
content.description: AdaDomains is a blockchain-based naming system built on Cardano as a decentralized alternative to traditional DNS. In the project’s model, each domain is represented by NFTs that identify the domain itself and its ownership, while associated data is stored on-chain in UTXOs with inline datums. The system is designed so human-readable .ada names can resolve to Cardano wallet addresses, regular or IPFS-hosted websites, socials, contact details, and other custom attributes. AdaDomains also supports subdomains and third-party integrations that want to use Cardano-based name resolution.
